text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS points_per_game, SUM(reb) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS rebounds_per_game, SUM(ast) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS assists_per_game FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE played = 1 AND LOWER(player_name) IN ('lebron james', 'stephen curry') AND game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY player_id, player_name ORDER BY player_name, player_id LIMIT 500
